improvements: Review establishes a concise conclusion, blocking contradiction, safe next action, and persistent deployed proof.
Claims uses grouped authority stages and a complete mobile path rather than a squeezed decorative graph.
Verify makes observed deployment and candidate not_applied authority unambiguous.
Trace is visually and semantically separate from Evidence while retaining validated-record cross-links.
All modes share one case, shell, palette, type system, authority model, and evidence vocabulary.
remaining_gaps: Owner must validate whether the mobile nine-record path is fast enough for real review.
Synthetic static interactions do not prove graph performance at production scale.
Owner must confirm the restrained orange risk language is sufficiently prominent without causing alarm fatigue.
